text: The problem is that you cannot know, first of all when you arrive in Israel you need to translate and notarized the documents it can take bit of time. Then, you apply online and you can wait between 2 to 6+ months to have the appointment and the working visa. In the meantime you are not authorized to work at all and to leave the country. On my case, it took me 5 months to have the B1 and now I am looking for a job and it's super tough.
